_schema_note: Catalog of vetted alternative components and version upgrades for the What-If Supply Chain Simulator. Used to simulate component replacements and quantify risk reduction.

options.label: AMI MegaRAC SP-X v13.1 (Patched OEM Upgrade)
options.notes: Direct vendor upgrade past affected v12.5 boundary. Remediates CVE-2023-34329 (Redfish Auth Bypass, CVSS 9.1) and CVE-2023-34330 (Root RCE, CVSS 8.2).

options.label: OpenBMC / ASPEED v2.14 (Hardened Baseline)
options.notes: Transition from proprietary MegaRAC to vetted open-source OpenBMC stack on Aspeed AST2600. Patched against CVE-2019-6260 ('Pantsdown').

options.label: Broadcom NetXtreme Firmware v22.40 (Patched)
options.notes: Upgrade past v21.60 affected range. Remediates simulated packet parsing buffer overflow (CVE-2021-3711-SIM, CVSS 9.1).

options.label: Intel E810 Ethernet Controller Firmware v4.30
options.notes: Alternative Tier-1 NIC vendor with active firmware support and no current critical CVE exposure.

options.label: Broadcom MegaRAID Firmware v53.10.0 (Patched)
options.notes: Remediates privilege escalation flaw in utility config (CVE-2023-22809-SIM, CVSS 7.8).

options.label: AMI Aptio V UEFI Firmware v6.0 (SMM Patched)
options.notes: Remediates SMM memory corruption vulnerability (CVE-2022-31160-SIM, CVSS 8.2). Verified in clean 4-node rack demo.

options.label: Axis Communications M3065-V (TAA/NDAA Compliant)
options.notes: Swedish surveillance manufacturer. Clears U.S. NDAA Section 889 / FCC Covered List restricted-vendor violation.

options.label: Hanwha Vision XNV-6080R (NDAA Compliant)
options.notes: South Korean manufacturer; fully compliant with federal procurement standards.
